study type: Descriptive study of a surgical technique (case series)
exposure: Precise circular resection of the uterine tissue at the placental attachment part following end-to-end anastomosis
outcome: Packed red blood cells units transfusion
cohort: Patients diagnosed with placenta previa complicated with placenta percreta (PPWPP) undergoing pregnancy termination at 34-36 weeks of gestation.
finding: The precise circular resection following end-to-end anastomosis is an effective surgical approach for PPWPP, achieving hemostasis while maximizing organ function protection and reducing surgical trauma.
mod_finding: The study evaluates a specific surgical technique performed during pregnancy termination, which typically involves a cesarean section, for managing placenta previa complicated with placenta percreta.
followup_time: N/A (Follow-up observations were made post-discharge, but no specific duration was mentioned)
